name: Site-mention dictionary (design f5; outcomes Y4 and Y5)
source: data/processed/facilities.csv (Phase 2, 214 sites, 59 tickers), which supersedes the Phase 0 file data/interim/facility_locatability.csv named in f5 (amendment A17). Terms curated by the analyst from the facility, location_as_written and geocode_place columns; no corpus text was searched or counted.

rules.unit: one paragraph (or split piece) of the firm's own documents; only that firm's sites are matched
rules.preprocessing: the firm's exclude_phrases (its own name where it contains a site term) are deleted from the text before matching
rules.R1: place term (not ambiguous): case-insensitive whole-word match of the term, together with at least one facility-context term anywhere in the same paragraph (f5: 'town or estate name together with that firm's facility context within the same paragraph')
rules.R2: ambiguous place term (any ambiguity flag except firm-name collision): case-sensitive match, and a facility-context term in the same sentence (sentences split at . ! ? followed by a space)
rules.R3: facility proper name or licence (e.g. 'MTN Plaza', 'Qua Iboe', 'OML 40'): the name is itself the facility, so it counts on its own, case-sensitive. 'R3+R2': an ambiguous facility name also needs a facility-context term in the same sentence
rules.generic_words: generic words such as 'plant' or 'factory' are never terms on their own (f5); they are only context terms
rules.site_named: a paragraph names site S if any term of S matches under its rule. Y4: physical-risk climate paragraphs naming at least one of the firm's sites. Y5: site S named in any of the firm's documents 2020-2025, in any context (any section, including notes that name sites, f1)
rules.shared_terms_within_firm: where one term belongs to several sites of the same firm (e.g. NB 'Aba': brewery, malting plant and sales office), a match names all of them; the site-level Y5 therefore cannot separate such sites
